name: Flow Controller
description: Inspect the irrigation channel and solve a fraction split so water is shared fairly.

steps.description: Collect mineral evidence from the river edge.
Collect a reed fiber sample from the bank.
Inspect the irrigation channel sign and compare the three branches.
If A gets 2/5 and B gets 1/5, calculate that C gets 2/5.

reward.label: Balanced flow
reward.childMessage: You used fractions to keep water moving fairly.
